proposed_decisions: Symbol tau: same role as the estimand of def:p15-factorial-assignment; tau_k (unit contrast) and tau_U (target estimand) are local to sec:p15-w02b-p15-075.
Symbols rho_k, rho_kl: inclusion probabilities, chosen to avoid pi_i(t), the assignment probability of def:p15-factorial-assignment; scoped to sec:p15-w02b-p15-075-sampling.
Symbol V_k: covariate (effect-modifier letter of the cited source); V_b and widehat V are variances; all local with distinct typography.
Symbol sigma(z): selection term, not a standard deviation; D(z): naive contrast, not D_AB of def:p15-factorial-coding; scoped to sec:p15-w02b-p15-075-observational.
Symbol script B: set of blocks; plain B is the number of blocks in thm:p15-factorial-blocks and a variance bound in thm:p15-w02b-p15-075-chebyshev; keep scoped rows.
Symbols S_t^2, S_w^2 use N-1 denominators; sigma_C^2 of def:p15-finite-population-sampling uses N; the relation is stated in the annex of thm:p15-w02b-p15-075-inclusion.
